# Original money movement qualification

`scripts/ci/test-promo-profit-movements-financial.py` reuses the maintained return bootstrap through its return migration, then loads the exact retained cash admission/addon/pending/cashout source captures and current scoped catalog. The W core, composed movement block (including its real money-RPC registration), and actual event consumer are extracted from the explicit `--w-source` input. BBJ/nonwallet source blocks are qualified separately, not replaced here.

Run from FIRST with external TMPDIR:

```
PG_BIN=/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@17/bin TMPDIR=/Volumes/SmarterWork/agent-work/extreme-capacity/pt01e4 python3 scripts/ci/test-promo-profit-movements-financial.py --output <new-external-evidence-directory> --pg-bin /opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@17/bin --w-source <composed-190221.sql>
```

The portable native proof executes three flows and 29 independently written conditional assertions, retaining exact bound input hashes. It retains the original 35 financial owner pins and 31 bank triggers, plus four actual origin-mode seat/pending tally/balance triggers and the exact production `table_stack` coverage/refuse mode. No ledger, tally, money owner, constructor, or event consumer is a fixture sink.

The opening 80 already-accounted wallet chips includes a typed original-source earning of 40. The actual W constructor tags that money; it does not mint it. The original disbursement provides P50, and a typed retained review case provides H20 with W/H overlap10. This qualifies original money movements and their P/H/W conservation, not the original earning/case producers. Existing controlled replica-mode structural openings belong to the maintained native financial route; this is not a production admin-write/replica-policy qualification.

Actual tested original owners perform player-to-own-agent claim, agent-to-own-player stake, cash buyin40, pending add-on80, partial application35/refund45, and whole-seat cashout75. The final player balance130 retains union100 and cashable30. Exact operation/occupancy replays and changed intent preserve state. A late XX001 fault after original money and W/H moves rolls back all money, journals, custody, and original intent/receipt rows. Every successful flow commits with all deferred financial constraints immediate.

The real DDL guard found one source issue: `fn_ca_promo_profit_snapshot_funding` needed an approved money-RPC registration before creation because it pins a validated first empty seat's funding club. The W owner added that source row. Remaining setup failures were exact catalog prerequisites missing from the return-only fixture (valid cash-game/table linkage, blacklist relation, felt coverage/refuse mode, and actual felt tally triggers); no guard was bypassed.

Current capture files are the ten JSON files in this directory. They contain only read-only function/catalog captures, no account rows or credentials. Integrate this finite proof into the existing maintained W native route before delivery; it never installs source in production.
